metadata.title: Gritty Country Portrait with Smoke Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A rugged, low-key portrait of a male figure in a cowboy hat featuring distressed block lettering and ethereal smoke-based graphic elements.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man wearing a cowboy hat and casual t-shirt, positioned slightly off-center against a dark, industrial background. The image uses a desaturated, olive-sepia color grade with high contrast. To the left of the subject, large distressed sans-serif text is stacked vertically, accompanied by a numerical symbol rendered as a wispy smoke trail.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's gaze directed at the viewer creates a direct connection
Distressed text texture mirrors the ruggedness of the subject's attire
Smoke trail element bridges the gap between the solid text and the dark background
High-contrast lighting emphasizes the texture of the hat and clothing
coreInvariants: Distressed, weathered texture on all typographic elements
Low-key lighting with deep shadows in the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, medium-close-up scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the brim of the cowboy hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves down to the hands, then left to the large text and smoke symbol.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy shadows on the left and top-right provide space for typography and atmospheric depth.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale cream highlights on skin and clothing
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the distressed text and smoke
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high tonal contrast; shadows are crushed while highlights are blown out for a gritty look.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy distressing and erosion applied to edges and surfaces
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numerical symbols are rendered as organic, wispy smoke trails rather than solid glyphs

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in negative space over background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Solid distressed block text paired with ethereal, fluid smoke-like symbols.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel.
Captures the weathered, tactile quality of the edges.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty, low-key portrait of a man in a cowboy hat and t-shirt, sepia-olive color grade, industrial dark background with smoke wisps.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay large, condensed, distressed white uppercase text on the left. Add a numerical character below the text rendered as a realistic smoke trail.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette restricted to olive, charcoal, and cream?
Does the text look weathered and eroded?
Is the numerical symbol rendered as smoke rather than a solid font?
Is the lighting high-contrast and moody?

mustRedesign: Do not use existing brand logos
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the smoke trail looks integrated into the atmosphere
Verify the text tracking is tight enough to feel like a solid block
Check that the sepia tint is consistent across the subject and background
Confirm the cowboy hat brim creates a strong shadow across the eyes
recipe.reuseFormula: Rugged Portrait + Distressed Block Type + Smoke Symbolism + Olive-Sepia Grade
